name: Broncus Holding Corporation
summary: Broncus Holding Corporation is a medical technology company developing interventional pulmonology products for China, the EU, the US and other markets. Its navigation systems LungPoint, LungPoint Plus and LungPro guide lung biopsies in real time. Therapeutic products include InterVapor thermal vapor ablation for hyper-inflated lung, an RF ablation system for lung cancer, the H-Marker, and needles such as BioStarNeedle and FleXNeedle.
